name: Meadow Afterglow
mood: Familiar wildflowers,ferns,a moth anda wren in gentle twilight botanical light.
credits: Glaze original built-in image_gen artwork and authored native identity. Botanical macro-photography style with restrained fluorescence-inspired light.
prompt: Use case: natural botanical artwork. GLAZE MEADOW AFTERGLOW. Jared requested LESS ABSTRACT NATURE-INSPIRED themes:show recognisable REAL flowers,ferns,moths and woodland birds with natural anatomy and believable textures. Visual medium: beautifully detailed botanical/wildlife MACRO PHOTOGRAPHY with very restrained UV-induced-visible-fluorescence-inspired twilight lighting. Nature comes first;the optical treatment is subtle. Familiar leaf greens,ivory petals,pollen gold,soft lilac flowers and warm brown feathers. A faint cool pearl/mint response in pollen or thin petal edges,and a very slight wine tint in some leaf veins,are the only unusual colour accents. Soft diffuse illumination,delicate natural tissue translucency,real botanical detail,no glitter or hard neon halo. Polished calm nature photograph,not an experiment diagram. No invented organisms,mechanical plants,geometric bodies,voxel cells,scientific maps,skeleton networks,glass/clay sculptures,metal,paper craft,fabric,cartoon face,CGI toy,fluorescent rainbow or exaggerated magical glow. Actual familiar natural shapes and textures throughout. No letters,numbers,labels,scale bar,diagram,UI,clock,reading,logo or watermark.
